## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `VoidRay-win-x64.exe` |
| Android (most phones), recommended | `VoidRay-android-arm64-v8a.apk` |
| Android (all devices) | `VoidRay-android-universal.apk` |
| Google Play version, for Play Console only (can't be installed directly) | `VoidRay-android-play-store.aab` |

## What's new

- **Windows: no more `VoidRay-win-x64.exe.old` after an update.** The previous version is now deleted automatically once it has finished closing (it used to stay next to the app because Windows still had it locked for a moment). The one left by your last update is removed too when 1.5.8 starts.
- Android: no change since 1.5.2.
